name: Should I choose porcelain tile or natural marble for my bathroom shower and floor?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose porcelain tile or natural marble for my bathroom shower and floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic and porcelain tile offer superior moisture resistance and easy maintenance, while natural marble delivers a luxurious, one-of-a-kind appearance that requires routine sealing. Porcelain is dense, highly scratch-resistant, and virtually impervious to water, making it a reliable choice for high-use family bathrooms. Natural marble adds distinct veining and depth, but it is softer, porous, and prone to staining or etching from acidic cleaners. If you select marble, you must plan on periodic resealing and using pH-neutral cleaning products to protect the stone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain is durable, low-maintenance, and highly water-resistant. Marble provides a high-end natural aesthetic but requires regular sealing and gentle cleaning.
